newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MIXED AGAINST MAJOR UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MIXED AGAINST MAJOR UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted easier against European currencies and the rand, reflecting overseas market trends, but closed firmer on the U.S. dollar on Tuesday, dealers said.
"People were showing longish positions (in their U.S. dollar holdings) at the end of the day. I'm not sure where the money was coming from but it wasn't that much really," one dealer commented.
"The Reserve Bank didn't intervene and I don't see them doing that tomorrow either," he added.

At Tuesday's close, the Zimbabwe dollar was a fraction up on the U.S. unit at 10.8625/8775 compared to Monday's 10.8650/8800 but eased marginally against sterling to 18.1530/1900 from 18.1500/1800, tracking the U.S. dollar's perfomance overseas.
It was at 6.8480/8615 from 6.8400/8700 versus the mark and at 2.3245/3300 against South Africa's rand, a slight drop from 2.3200/3400 the previous day.
